decision: The separately prospective standards-aware loader is deterministic, bounded, ownership-safe and applies the OpenEXR default Rec.709/D65 rule only under explicit caller authorization. However, the exact official Rec709 and XYZ reference files do not converge to the frozen common linear Rec.2020/D65 tolerance: RMSE 0.0266167, p99 absolute error 0.0930788 and maximum absolute error 0.560012 all fail. The exact source/matrix/threshold family closes without a white-point, matrix, source or threshold rescue.
excluded_first_reports: The first committed-head reports already failed the same three cross-source gates with identical comparison metrics and output hashes, but the audit emitted zero_new_boundary as a structural constant. They are excluded before evidence. Commit 690c3ee8 adds actual per-source/output exact-boundary measurement only; sources, arithmetic, thresholds, comparison metrics, controls, stop rule and decision are unchanged, and corrected formal execution restarts from committed HEAD.
interpretation: OpenEXR's default Rec.709 identity can be implemented deterministically and safely, but this two-file official reference pair does not provide a sufficiently tight numerical equivalence test for the frozen Bradford-to-D65 representation. The result does not justify a default loader or a different adaptation convention. The private core remains unexported and unintegrated research code; exact P296 is closed.
claim_ceiling: One exact two-source standards-aware OpenEXR numerical compatibility negative. No arbitrary EXR, DCI-P3/ACES, HDR/display quality, default dispatch, public dependency/API/package/schema/capability/product, stock evidence or candidate-3 change.
